BL-0.1.4-009-S1.title: Define Mongo Query Size Estimation Contract
BL-0.1.4-009-S1.description: Define a standard schema for estimating Mongo query size including document count, byte size approximation, and safety thresholds aligned with existing GPTReader limits.

BL-0.1.4-009-S2.title: Implement Query Size Estimation Logic
BL-0.1.4-009-S2.description: Build core logic to estimate Mongo query response size prior to execution using document count and average document size heuristics, explicitly incorporating existing 100-document limit and 500KB response cap enforcement alignment.

BL-0.1.4-009-S3.title: Integrate Size Guard into GPTReader API
BL-0.1.4-009-S3.description: Integrate query size estimation into GPTReader request handling to block, truncate, or short-circuit oversized queries before execution and return structured warnings and metadata (estimated_size, limit_hit).

BL-0.1.4-009-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Query Size Guards
BL-0.1.4-009-S4.description: Create tests validating estimation accuracy, enforcement of limits, safe truncation behavior, and handling of edge cases such as large documents, high-cardinality queries, and near-threshold responses.

BL-0.1.4-009-S5.title: Integrate Query Size Estimation with Data Pipeline Workflows
BL-0.1.4-009-S5.description: Ensure query size estimation is respected in pipeline contexts (e.g., batch reads, embedding jobs) to prevent oversized reads, including graceful degradation (batch splitting or early termination).
